item.title: NYT: "Saudi Arabia Opens the Door to Uranium Enrichment… Questions Arise: 'Why Not South Korea?'" (NYT “사우디, 우라늄 농축 길 열어…‘왜 한국은 안 되나’ 질문 나와”)
item.description:
As analysis emerges that Saudi Arabia has secured potential uranium enrichment rights through a nuclear agreement with the United States, criticism has been raised that the Trump administration is applying a "double standard" by failing to make substantial progress in enrichment negotiations with South Korea. (사우디아라비아가 미국과 원자력협정을 맺어 잠재적인 우라늄 농축 권한을 확보했다는 분석이 나온 가운데 미국 도널드 트럼프 행정부가 한국에 대해서는 농축 협상을 제대로 진전시키지 않아 ‘이중잣대’를 적용하고 있다는 지적이 나왔다.)

The New York Times (NYT) noted in an article on the 23rd (local time) about the U.S.-Saudi nuclear agreement that "by signing an agreement that could pave the way for Saudi Arabia to enrich uranium on its own soil, the United States has triggered an unavoidable question from South Korea: 'Why does Saudi Arabia get to do this and not us?'" The newspaper pointed out, "For decades, the United States has taken a firm stance against South Korea, including banning its uranium enrichment, but the Trump administration now appears to have effectively broken that standard." (뉴욕타임스(NYT)는 23일(현지시각) 미·사우디 원자력 협정 관련 기사에서 “사우디가 자국 영토에서 우라늄을 농축할 수 있는 길로 이어질 수 있는 협정을 체결함으로써 미국은 한국으로부터 ‘왜 사우디는 되고 우리는 안 되는가’라는 피할 수 없는 질문을 촉발했다”고 지적했다. 신문은 “수십 년 동안 미국은 한국의 우라늄 농축을 금지하는 등 한국에 단호한 입장을 취해왔지만, 이번에 트럼프 행정부가 그 기준을 사실상 깨뜨린 것으로 보인다”고 지적했다.)

The United States and Saudi Arabia signed a nuclear cooperation agreement (123 Agreement) under Section 123 of the U.S. Atomic Energy Act on the 22nd. Although the U.S. Department of Energy has not clearly disclosed the details of the nuclear agreement with Saudi Arabia, U.S. media reports indicate that the agreement includes provisions allowing U.S. companies to operate uranium enrichment facilities in Saudi Arabia. It is reportedly structured so that the U.S. and Saudi Arabia will conduct joint research for two years before making a final decision on whether to operate uranium enrichment facilities in Saudi Arabia. President Trump also demanded that Saudi Arabia normalize relations with Israel as a condition. (미국과 사우디는 지난 22일 미국 원자력법 123조에 따른 원자력 협력 협정(123협정)에 서명했다. 미국 에너지부가 아직 사우디와의 핵협정 내용을 명확하게 공개하지 않았지만, 미국 언론 보도를 보면 이 협정에는 미국 기업이 사우디 내에서 우라늄 농축 시설을 운영하는 조항이 포함돼 있다. 우선 미국과 사우디가 2년간 공동연구를 한 뒤 사우디 내에 우라늄 농축 시설을 운영할지를 최종 결정하는 것으로 알려졌다. 트럼프 대통령은 사우디가 이스라엘과 수교하는 것을 조건으로 요구하기도 했다.)

The New York Times noted that South Korea has joined the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT), accepted strict safeguards, and operates 26 nuclear reactors. It assessed that South Korea has long negotiated with the U.S. over uranium enrichment rights, and granting potential enrichment rights to Saudi Arabia—which has not yet built any nuclear power plants—constitutes a double standard against South Korea. The article also highlighted that while Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman stated in a 2018 CBS interview that "if Iran develops nuclear weapons, we will follow suit," the South Korean government has repeatedly pledged never to pursue nuclear weapons. Although North Korea's nuclear capabilities are increasingly dangerous, fueling public opinion in South Korea for nuclear armament, the South Korean government maintains that for peaceful and commercial use of nuclear energy, enrichment and reprocessing are necessary to ensure a stable supply of nuclear fuel and address spent fuel issues. (뉴욕타임스는 한국은 핵확산금지조약(NPT)에 가입하고 엄격한 안전조치를 수용했으며 26기의 원자로를 가동하고 있다면서, 한국은 오랜 기간 미국과 우라늄 농축 권리를 놓고 협상해왔는데 아직 원전을 건설하지도 않은 사우디가 잠재적 농축 권한을 확보한 것은 한국에 대해 이중잣대가 된다고 평가했다. 또 사우디의 무함마드 빈 살만 왕세자가 2018년 시비에스(CBS) 방송과의 인터뷰에서 “이란이 핵무기를 개발하면 자국도 핵을 보유할 것”이라고 공언한 바 있지만, 한국 정부는 결코 핵무기를 추구하지 않을 것이라고 거듭 약속해왔다는 점도 짚었다. 북한 핵 능력이 점점 더 위험해지면서 한국 내에서 핵무장 여론이 높아진 것은 사실이지만 한국 정부는 원자력의 평화적·상업적 이용 측면에서 원전 연료의 원활한 공급과 사용 후 연료 문제 해결을 위해 농축·재처리가 필요하다는 입장을 견지하고 있다.)

The New York Times noted, "This agreement raises expectations for progress in U.S.-South Korea nuclear negotiations," but also pointed out that "if the U.S. continues to ignore South Korea's demands, it could plant the seeds of a deep rift in the 70-year-old alliance." (뉴욕타임스는 “이번 협정이 한국과 미국의 (원자력) 협상 진전에 대한 기대를 높이고 있다”면서도 “미국이 계속 한국의 요구를 무시할 경우 70년 된 동맹 관계에 깊은 균열의 씨앗이 될 수도 있다”고 지적했다.)

The joint fact sheet from the South Korea-U.S. summit announced last November included a political agreement stating that "the U.S. supports procedures leading to South Korea's peaceful use of civilian uranium enrichment and spent nuclear fuel reprocessing, consistent with the U.S.-South Korea nuclear cooperation agreement and within the bounds of U.S. legal requirements." Based on this, South Korea and the U.S. held their first negotiations on enrichment and reprocessing in early June. However, amid U.S. complaints about delays in South Korean investment in the U.S. and issues like Coupang, the second round of U.S.-South Korea negotiations continues to be delayed. (지난해 11월 발표된 한-미 정상회담 공동설명자료(조인트 팩트시트)는 “미국은 한-미 원자력 협력 협정에 부합하고, 미국의 법적 요건을 준수하는 범위 내에서 한국의 평화적 이용을 위한 민간 우라늄 농축 및 사용후핵연료 재처리로 이어지는 절차를 지지한다”는 내용의 정치적 합의가 포함됐다. 이를 바탕으로 한·미는 지난 6월 초 농축·재처리 협상을 처음 진행했다. 하지만, 한국의 대미투자가 지연된다는 미국의 불만과 쿠팡 문제 등이 이어지는 가운데 한·미 2차 협상이 계속 미뤄지고 있다.)

The government has also taken the stance that it will first examine the specific details of this agreement to assess its impact on U.S.-South Korea negotiations. A Foreign Ministry official stated, "Since nuclear cooperation trends between the U.S. and other countries, including Saudi Arabia, may have implications for U.S.-South Korea cooperation, we are continuously monitoring the trends of U.S. foreign policy in the nuclear sector." (정부도 일단은 이번 협정의 구체적 내용을 파악해 한·미 협상에 미칠 영향은 따져보겠다는 태도다. 외교부 당국자는 “미국과 사우디 포함 여타국 간 원자력 협력 동향은 한·미 간 관련 협력에도 함의가 있을 수 있는 만큼 우리로서는 미국의 원자력 분야 대외정책 동향도 지속 예의주시 중”이라고 말했다.)

Analysts say that the U.S. opening the door for Saudi Arabia to potentially possess enrichment and reprocessing capabilities is largely driven by geopolitical factors—Saudi Arabia being a key player in U.S. Middle East policy—and strategic considerations that if the U.S. does not build nuclear plants in Saudi Arabia, the kingdom could align with China or Russia. (미국이 사우디에 잠재적인 농축·재처리 보유의 길을 열어준 데는 미국 중동 정책에서 사우디가 핵심이라는 지정학적 요소와 미국이 사우디에 원전을 짓지 않으면 사우디가 중국, 러시아와 손을 잡을 수 있다는 전략적 고려가 크게 작용했다는 분석이다.)

However, experts note that the U.S.-Saudi agreement has set a precedent altering the U.S. strict stance on nuclear non-proliferation, and argue that South Korea should leverage this in its negotiations with the U.S. Cho Seong-ryeol, a visiting professor of military studies at Kyungnam University, said, "The U.S. has created an important precedent by changing its previous stance of not transferring enrichment and reprocessing technology, first to India and now to Saudi Arabia. South Korea should also emphasize these precedents in negotiations with the U.S. to secure peaceful-use enrichment and reprocessing rights for operating nuclear plants." (하지만, 전문가들은 미-사우디 협정이 미국의 강경한 핵 비확산 태도를 바꾸는 선례가 됐다는 점에 주목하면서 한국도 미국과의 협상에서 이를 잘 활용해야 한다고 말한다. 조성렬 경남대 군사학과 초빙교수는 “미국이 인도에 이어 사우디에서도 농축·재처리 기술을 이전하지 않는다는 기존 태도를 바꾸는 중요한 전례를 남긴 것”이라며 “한국도 미국과의 협상에서 이런 전례들을 강조하면서 원전 가동을 위한 평화적 목적의 농축·재처리 권리를 확보해야 한다”고 말했다.)

The 2008 U.S.-India civilian nuclear agreement sparked controversy over double standards by exceptionally allowing nuclear technology and materials to India—a country that had not joined the NPT and possessed nuclear weapons—to operate nuclear plants. This was part of the Bush administration's strategy to draw India toward the U.S. to counter the rising competitor, China. The 1987 U.S.-Japan nuclear agreement was also an exceptional measure, where the U.S. recognized Japan's already-acquired enrichment and reprocessing technology. (2008년 미국과 인도가 맺은 민간핵협정은 핵확산금지조약에 가입하지 않고 핵무기까지 보유한 인도에 이례적으로 핵기술과 핵물질을 제공해 원전을 가동하게 허용했다는 점에서 이중잣대 논란을 일으켰다. 당시 부시 행정부가 ‘경쟁자’로 떠오르는 중국을 겨냥해 인도를 미국 쪽으로 끌어들이려는 전략에 따른 것이었다. 1987년 미국과 일본의 원자력협정도 일본이 이미 확보하고 있던 농축·재처리 기술을 미국이 인정한 예외적 조처다.)

Park Min-hee, Senior Reporter minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party’s ‘collar-grabbing incident’ leading to disciplinary measures? What’s the big deal with standing committees? (국힘 ‘멱살 소동’ 징계 수순? 상임위원회가 뭐길래)
item.description:
<<>> In the People Power Party (PPP), which agreed to accept seven standing committee chair positions for the latter half of the National Assembly and decided to return to parliamentary activities after about 50 days, internal conflict has erupted again over the allocation of standing committees. On the 23rd, second-term lawmaker Kwon Young-jin, dissatisfied with his committee assignment, visited the floor leader’s office and grabbed the collars of both the current and former floor leaders—a disgraceful scene showcasing the old-fashioned ways of politics. While internal calls for disciplinary action against Kwon have emerged and he has apologized, the controversy shows no signs of subsiding. ()

■ “Floor leader’s authority reduced to a collar-grabbing situation”… Internal discontent boiling over in PPP ( 후반기 국회 상임위원장직 7곳 배정을 수락하고 50여일만에 원내 활동에 복귀하기로 한 국민의힘에서 이번엔 상임위원회 배분을 두고 당내 갈등이 폭발했다. 재선 권영진 의원이 23일 상임위 배정에 불만을 갖고 원내대표실을 찾아 전·현직 원내대표의 멱살을 잡은 일은 볼썽사나운 정치의 구태를 보여주는 한 장면이었다. 당내에서 권 의원에 대한 징계 필요성이 거론됐고 권 의원은 사과했지만 논란이 가라앉지 않는 모습이다. )

PPP Floor Leader Jung Jeom-sik only attended a wreath-laying ceremony at the Seoul National Cemetery on the morning of the 24th, alongside the National Assembly speaker, parliamentary leaders from both parties, and standing committee chairs, but skipped the floor leadership meeting held at the Assembly. A floor leader’s office official said, “Everyone must have seen the situation where the floor leader’s authority boiled down to a collar-grabbing incident. The floor leader will not attend today’s meeting.” ( ■“원내대표 권위가 멱살로 귀결되는 상황”…국힘 내부 부글부글)

The ‘collar-grabbing commotion’ occurred right after the PPP’s floor leadership announced committee assignments to lawmakers the previous day. Kwon visited the floor leader’s office, protesting that he had been assigned as the secretary of the Public Administration and Security Committee rather than the Intelligence Committee he had hoped for, and grabbed Floor Leader Jung by the collar. It is reported that a physical scuffle ensued as other lawmakers tried to intervene. Lawmaker Kang Min-kook, assigned to the Strategy and Finance Committee, is also said to have verbally abused Chief Deputy Floor Leader Kim Seung-su while protesting his committee assignment. ( 정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 24일 오전 22대 후반기 국회 의장단과 여야 원내대표, 상임위원장단과 함께한 국립서울현충원 참배 일정만 소화하고 국회에서 열린 원내대책회의에는 불참했다. 원내대표실 관계자는 “원내대표의 권위가 멱살로 귀결되는 상황을 모두 지켜보셨을 것이다. 원내대표께서는 금일 회의에 불참한다”고 했다. )

During the floor leadership meeting that day, public messages criticizing the incident poured in. Secretary-General Jung Hee-yong stated, “A shameful and appalling incident occurred. A lawmaker, dissatisfied with his committee assignment, grabbed the floor leader’s collar, and even grabbed the collar of a former floor leader who tried to intervene. Protests and physical actions must be distinguished. Violence can never be justified.” The deputy floor leader team issued a statement demanding a party-wide meeting, saying, “We must hold strict and decisive accountability through proper procedures.” The PPP’s secretariat also said, “Protests and violence are different,” urging Kwon to “apologize to the people and party members ten times over.” Over 40 district party chapter chairs outside the Assembly argued in a statement, “Kwon should be immediately referred to the Ethics Committee and subjected to the highest level of disciplinary action.” ( ‘멱살 소동’은 전날 국민의힘 원내지도부가 의원들에게 배정된 상임위를 발표한 직후 벌어졌다. 권 의원이 원내대표실을 찾아 자신이 희망한 정보위원회가 아닌, 행정안전위원회 간사로 배정됐다고 항의하며 정 원내대표의 멱살을 잡았다. 함께 있던 의원들이 말리는 과정에서 몸싸움도 이어졌다고 한다. 재정경제기획위원회에 배치된 강민국 의원도 상임위 배정에 항의하며 김승수 원내운영수석부대표에게 욕설을 한 것으로 전해졌다.)

Kwon expressed his position in a party lawmakers’ group chat that day, saying, “I deeply reflect on my carelessness and wrongdoing and apologize. Regardless of the reasons, my words and actions were entirely due to my shortcomings and mistakes. I committed a grave discourtesy to Floor Leader Jung and wounded his leadership.” Having previously declared himself as the sole candidate for the PPP Daegu City Party Chair, he later stated in a regional lawmakers’ group chat that “it seems inappropriate for me to serve as city party chair” and withdrew his candidacy. Nevertheless, the likelihood of disciplinary action is growing. Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon told reporters at the Assembly that day, “There is a consensus that this issue should not simply be brushed aside with an apology. Once a disciplinary request is filed, I believe the party will take firm and stringent measures.” ( 이날 원내대책회의에선 이를 비판하는 공개 메시지가 이어졌다. 정희용 사무총장은 “부끄럽고 참담한 일이 발생했다. 상임위 배정에 불만을 품은 의원이 원내대표의 멱살을 잡았고 , 이를 말리던 전임 원내대표의 멱살까지 잡는 일이 있었다 ”며 “항의와 물리적 행위는 구분돼야 한다 . 폭력은 결코 정당화될 수 없다 ”고 말했다 . 원내부대표단은 입장문을 내고 “합당한 절차에 따라 엄중하고 단호하게 책임을 물어야 한다”며 의원총회 소집을 요구했다. 국민의힘 사무처도 “항의와 폭력은 다르다”라며 권 의원을 향해 “열 번이라도 국민과 당원에게 사죄해야 한다”고 했다. 원외 당협위원장 40여명은 입장문에서 “권 의원을 즉각 윤리위원회에 회부하고 최고 수준의 징계를 해야 한다”고 주장했다. )

■ Heated battle over ‘prime standing committee’ slots… ( 권 의원은 이날 의원 단체대화방에 “저의 불찰과 잘못을 깊이 반성하고 사과드린다”며 “저의 언행은 이유여하를 불문하고 무조건 저의 부족함이고 잘못이었다. 정 원내대표께 큰 결례를 범하고 리더십에 상처를 드렸다”고 입장을 밝혔다. 앞서 국민의힘 대구시당위원장 자리에 단독 출사표를 던졌던 그는 이날 지역 국회의원 단체대화방을 통해 “제가 시당위원장을 맡는 것은 부적절한 것 같다”며 출마 의사도 접었다. 그럼에도 징계 가능성은 커지는 분위기다. 박성훈 수석대변인은 이날 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “이번 사안을 단순히 사과로 넘겨서는 안 된다는 공감대가 있다”며 “징계 요청서가 접수되는 대로 당의 단호하고 엄중한 조치가 이뤄지리라 생각한다”고 말했다.)

The competition between ruling and opposition parties over ‘prime standing committee chair’ positions, and within parties over the most coveted committee member seats, is nothing new. It’s hard to dismiss outright the hopes of lawmakers who want to review bills tied to their district interests or those with significant social impact. However, as such demands often concentrate on committees like the Budget and Accounts Special Committee, the National Policy Committee, the Land, Infrastructure and Transport Committee, and the Trade, Industry, Energy, SMEs and Startups Committee, the floor leadership responsible for distributing committee assignments frequently finds itself in a tough spot. The jockeying among lawmakers is also fierce. They apply for first, second, and third preferences, seeking committees where fewer colleagues will flock. ( ■과열되는 ‘알짜 상임위’ 쟁탈전…)

The Budget and Accounts Special Committee is popular because it facilitates securing district funding, while the Land and Transport Committee offers opportunities for local infrastructure expansion. The Industry Committee, dealing with corporate policies, and the National Policy Committee, handling issues like chaebol reform, fair trade, and financial policy, are favored for their immense influence in economic fields. The Agriculture, Food, Rural Affairs, Oceans and Fisheries Committee is also popular among lawmakers from rural constituencies. The Legislation and Judiciary Committee acts as an ‘upper house’ within the Assembly, boosting lawmakers’ profiles, making it highly sought-after. A floor leadership official lamented the difficulty of committee assignments, saying, “Lawmakers visit three or four times a week, so how many more calls do you think come in?” ( 여야는 ‘알짜 상임위원장’ 자리를 놓고, 당내에선 ‘알짜 상임위원’ 자리를 차지하기 위해 쟁탈전을 벌이는 모습은 새로운 장면은 아니다. 지역구 이해관계가 걸린 법안이나 사회적 파급력이 큰 법안을 심사하고 싶어하는 의원들 희망을 부적절하다고 단정하기도 어렵다. 다만 이런 의원들의 요구가 예산결산특별위원회, 정무위원회, 국토교통위원회, 산업통상자원중소벤처기업위원회 등에 주로 몰리다보니 상임위를 배분해야 하는 원내지도부 입장에서는 곤혹스러울 때가 많다. 의원들 눈치싸움도 치열하다. 선호하는 상임위 중 다른 의원들이 몰리지 않을 곳을 찾아 1,2,3순위를 신청하게 된다. )

Within the PPP, the distribution of committee chair positions for the latter half has also sparked discord. Although there is a practice of three-term lawmakers taking turns as committee chairs, this time it led to internal primaries. Fourth-term lawmaker Yoo Ui-dong, citing that he had yielded committee chair positions to senior lawmakers when he was a three-termer, challenged for the chair of the Land and Transport Committee after the lineup had been coordinated. He won the party’s internal election by a single vote over three-term lawmaker Kim Jeong-jae. Right after the vote, three-term lawmaker Lim Lee-ja, who had been slated as chair of the Gender Equality and Family Committee, announced she would yield the chair to Kim, with proceedings expected to proceed next week. ( 예결특위는 지역구 예산을 따내기 용이하고, 국토위는 지역구 인프라 확장을 노릴 수 있다는 이유로 다수 의원들이 희망한다. 또 산자위는 기업 관련 정책을, 정무위는 재벌개혁이나 공정거래, 금융 정책 등을 다루다 보니 경제 분야 영향력이 막강하다는 점이 선호 요소로 작용한다. 농어촌 지역구인 의원들 사이에선 농림축산식품해양수산위원회도 인기다. 법제사법위원회는 국회에서 ‘상원’ 역할을 하며 인지도를 얻는다는 점에서 의원들의 선호도가 높다. 원내지도부 관계자는 “일주일에 서너번씩 찾아오는데 전화는 얼마나 더 많이 오겠느냐”며 상임위 배정의 어려움을 토로했다. )

In this process, lawmaker Song Seok-joon, formerly of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, being assigned as chair of the Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee has also fueled talk. Song initially accepted the foreign affairs chair with a plan to serve for a year and then swap with Kim to take over the Land and Transport Committee, but with Yoo becoming its chair, the ‘yearly rotation’ has become uncertain. ( 국민의힘에선 후반기 상임위원장 배분을 두고도 잡음이 일었다. 통상 3선 의원이 상임위원장을 나눠맡는 관행이 있지만, 이번에는 경선을 치르게 됐기 때문이다. 4선 유의동 의원이 자신이 3선이었을 당시 연장자인 의원들에게 상임위원장을 양보했었다며 상임위원장직 조율이 끝난 뒤 국토위원장직에 도전장을 내밀었고, 당내 선거에서 3선 김정재 의원을 1표 차로 이기고 선출됐다. 투표 직후 성평등가족위원장으로 내정돼 있던 3선 임이자 의원이 김 의원에게 위원장직을 양보하겠다고 밝히면서 다음주 절차가 진행될 전망이다. )

By Cho Hee-yeon, Reporter choh@hani.co.kr ( 이 과정에서 국토부 출신인 송석준 의원이 외교통일위원장을 맡게 된 것도 뒷말이 나온다. 송 의원은 당초 외통위원장을 1년간 맡은 뒤 김 의원과 교대해 국토위원장을 할 구상으로 외통위원장직을 수락했는데 유 의원이 국토위원장이 되면서 ‘1년씩 나누기’가 불확실해졌다.)

item.title: Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Powers... Democratic Party: "Even the cautious faction had no opposition" (보완수사권 폐지…민주당 “신중파도 반대 없었다”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea has adopted as its official party line a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act centered on the "complete abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers." The party explained that robust supplementary measures have been put in place to address concerns over inadequate police investigations or investigation vacuums that may arise from the full abolition of supplementary investigation powers, and that lawmakers who had previously raised concerns did not oppose the measure as a result. The Democratic Party plans to finalize the bill on the 27th, undergo review by the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and handle the legislation in a plenary session as early as the 30th. <<> Lee Joo-hee, the Democratic Party's deputy floor spokesperson, said in a briefing after the party's policy meeting of lawmakers held at the National Assembly on the 24th that "106 out of 161 lawmakers participated and unanimously adopted (the revision to the Criminal Procedure Act) as party policy without objection." She stated that the direction for the bill's revision was set based on three principles: △prohibition of prosecutors' direct investigations, maintaining the separation of investigation and indictment; △expansion of measures to protect crime victims; and △strengthening mutual checks between investigative agencies. <<> Measures to protect the socially vulnerable established... New supplementary investigation powers for the Major Crimes Investigation Office <<> As a protective measure for crime victims following the abolition of supplementary investigation powers, for seven major crimes targeting the socially vulnerable (child abuse, domestic violence, sexual crimes, child sexual crimes, stalking, abuse of persons with disabilities, and elder abuse), the police are required to mandatorily transfer cases to the prosecution office regardless of whether a crime is suspected. However, the legal basis for this will be established in individual laws rather than the Criminal Procedure Act. Kim Han-kyu, the Democratic Party's senior deputy whip for policy, explained, "The principle is not to allow exceptions for mandatory transfer of all cases in the Criminal Procedure Act. Instead, since child abuse and domestic violence cases are already required to be transferred to the prosecution without a final judgment by judicial police officers, we are amending individual laws to cover the additional five crimes under the same principle." <<> Furthermore, even for general criminal cases, victims' rights to submit materials, state opinions to prosecutors, and prosecutors' rights to hear opinions (from case-related individuals) will be explicitly stipulated. Not only complainants, victims, and victims' legal representatives, but also accusers will be granted the right to file objections to investigations. Additionally, all investigation process materials will be digitized and recorded in the Criminal Justice Information System (KICS), and if prosecutors discover clues to other crimes while reviewing these records, they can request judicial police officers to conduct an investigation. <<> Checks between investigative agencies will also be strengthened. While formulating measures to make prosecutors' requests for supplementary investigations, reinvestigations, and corrective actions more substantive, higher-level investigative agencies, including the Major Crimes Investigation Office (MCIO), which will be established alongside the prosecution office on October 2, will be allowed to request police for supplementary investigations and reinvestigations. Additionally, for the seven major crimes targeting the socially vulnerable, the MCIO Act will be revised to establish a dedicated supplementary investigation unit within the MCIO, enabling it to conduct supplementary investigations directly. <<> Meanwhile, prosecutors' authority to direct investigations by special judicial police officers (SJPOs) will be abolished. However, a provision mandating cooperation between prosecutors and SJPOs in investigations, as well as a right for SJPOs to request cooperation from prosecutors, will be newly established. SJPOs are a system in which ordinary public officials are granted judicial police powers to crack down on crimes in specialized fields requiring expertise, such as food, pharmaceuticals, taxation, environment, and labor. However, the obligation for SJPOs to transfer all cases to prosecutors after investigation will remain intact. Senior Deputy Whip Kim explained, "Since SJPOs themselves lack legal knowledge and investigative experience, if they were to make final judgments, they would face legal liability. Therefore, many field SJPOs have strongly requested that, as at present, prosecutors be able to make the final judgment on cases." <<> In addition, plans call for establishing oversight bodies such as investigative human rights protection officers to protect victims robustly and ensure human rights are not violated during the investigation process. <<> Cautious faction within party also in favor: "Many supplementary measures reflected" <<> Lawmakers from the Democratic Party who had previously expressed concerns about the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers also agreed to the revision prepared by the party's floor leadership on this day. Rep. Hong Ki-won, who had proposed a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act allowing exceptional permission of supplementary investigation powers for crimes targeting the socially vulnerable, told *The Hankyoreh*, "The core purpose of my bill was to protect the socially vulnerable and alleviate the increased suffering of victims due to delays in handling investigation cases. But after listening to today's (floor leadership briefing), I found that many of the demands from crime victim groups and the issues I raised have been reflected." He added, "I expressed gratitude (at the lawmakers' meeting) for the leadership and the Legislation and Judiciary Committee's efforts to significantly supplement and strengthen victim protection provisions, and there was no particular objection to the adoption of the party policy." Rep. Kim Nam-hee, who co-proposed Rep. Hong's bill, also said, "It's regrettable, but since some supplementary measures have been partially reflected, I said I would follow the party policy. However, I am disappointed by the behavior of using this issue for political purposes even though the core of prosecution reform is not the abolition of supplementary investigation powers." <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당이 ‘검사 보완수사권 완전 폐지’를 뼈대로 하는 형사소송법 개정안을 당론으로 채택했다. 보완수사권 완전 폐지 때 우려되는 경찰의 부실 수사나 수사 공백에 대한 보완책을 두텁게 마련했고, 이에 그동안 우려를 제기해 온 의원들도 반대하지 않았다는 게 민주당 설명이다. 민주당은 오는 27일 최종안을 확정하고, 국회 법제사법위원회 심사를 거쳐 이르면 오는 30일 국회 본회의에서 법안을 처리하겠다는 계획이다.)

item.title: [Video] ‘They drew a line against election fraud claims,’ but Yoon Again group holds re-election rally in Hongdae ([영상] ‘부정선거 선 그었다’지만…윤어게인 단체, 홍대서 재선거 시위)
item.description:
As the Olympic Park ‘voting rights protest’ sparked by the ballot shortage incident became engulfed in ‘election fraud conspiracy theories,’ some young people moved to Hongdae to call for a ‘re-election.’ The media highlighted them as ‘young people who drew a line against election fraud conspiracy theories.’ However, our investigation revealed that the force behind the Hongdae rally was a far-right group. They were employing a detour strategy by using moderate slogans to draw citizens into the ‘election fraud’ discourse. <<> On June 27, near Hongdae Station, Park Tae-geun, the leader of the conservative youth group ‘BOSS,’ took the microphone and shouted “Restore voting rights.” But their actual goal was different. One video on BOSS’s YouTube channel contained a strategy stating, “After making them come without political bias, we make them realize (enlighten them) about ‘election fraud’ through searches.” Furthermore, during our crew’s coverage of the Hongdae site, when a citizen who participated in a sticker survey asking ‘Do you know about the Olympic Park protest?’ said “I can’t agree with election fraud,” they persuaded them by asking, “How about a slogan like re-election, which anyone can relate to?” After asking an elementary school student “Why is re-election not happening?” and getting the response “Election fraud…”, they immediately chimed in, saying, “Right, we need to determine whether it’s election fraud.” Our crew decided to ask Mr. Park directly, and unexpectedly, he readily explained, “Calling for election fraud makes people leave, so we put forward ‘re-election,’ which the entire nation can sympathize with.” He essentially admitted that the Hongdae rally was aimed at funneling participants toward the Olympic Park protest. <<> Experts analyzed this as a meticulous ‘lowering the threshold strategy’ by the far-right and pointed out the dangers of the ‘re-election’ slogan. Professor Kim Jong-woo of Yonsei University noted, “It’s a form of ‘de-demonization’ that lowers the threshold of extreme ideologies that are hard to accept,” and added, “They are trying to preempt an empty vessel with no content called ‘re-election’ to gain an advantage in ideological competition.” Professor Jeon Sang-jin of Sogang University warned, “It’s a franchise strategy of opening a branch in Hongdae following the main store at Olympic Park,” and stated, “The ‘re-election’ slogan itself, which omits diagnosing the cause, can be packaged as a moderate alternative and become a seed that fuels election fraud conspiracy theories.” <<> What has this group done so far? How will their activities impact the public discourse? What additional explanations did Mr. Park provide to our crew? For more details, check out the video. <<> Produced by Wi Jun-young and Jo Seong-uk marco0428@hani.co.kr (투표용지 부족 사태로 촉발된 올림픽공원 ‘참정권 시위’가 ‘부정선거 음모론’에 뒤덮이자, 일부 청년들은 홍대로 자리를 옮겨 ‘재선거’를 외쳤다. 언론은 이들을 ‘부정선거 음모론과 선을 그은 청년들’로 조명했다. 그러나 취재 결과 홍대 집회를 주도한 세력은 극우 성향 단체로 드러났다. 이들은 온건한 구호를 내세워 시민들을 ‘부정선거’ 담론으로 끌어들이는 우회 전략을 펴고 있었다.)

item.title: Supreme Council Candidate Pool Narrowed to 3 Pro-Jung Cheong-rae and 5 Pro-Lee Jae-myung ... Factional 'Tug-of-War' to Secure Majority in Leadership (최고위원 후보 친청 3명·친명 5명 압축…과반 사수 계파별 ‘눈치싸움’)
item.description:
With the finalists for the Supreme Council election at the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention determined, a fierce factional struggle is expected to unfold as pro-Lee Jae-myung (5 candidates) and pro-Jung Cheong-rae (3 candidates) factions compete to secure a majority in the leadership. To ensure a specific faction holds a majority (5 seats) in the nine-member new leadership—including the party leader and two appointed Supreme Council members—at least two elected Supreme Council members must be from that faction. <<> The fact that candidates classified as pro-Jung—Lee Seong-yoon, Han Min-soo, and Choi Min-hee—all advanced to the finals has led to analysis both inside and outside the party that the solidarity of the support base for party leader candidate Jung Cheong-rae has been confirmed. On the pro-Lee side, 10 candidates ran, with Park Seon-won, Kim Yong, Seo Mi-hwa, Kim Young-ho, and Im Mi-ae making it to the finals. A two-term lawmaker said on the 24th, "Candidate Han Min-soo has recognition among pro-Jung party members, Lee Seong-yoon has a base in the Honam region, and Choi Min-hee appears to have advanced by securing votes from the hardcore support base." A first-term lawmaker commented, "Candidate Jung's strategy of highlighting a weak image and stimulating the sentiments of his support base has been directly reflected." <<> As the race for party leadership enters its main phase, how party leader candidates will align with Supreme Council candidates and employ vote-gathering strategies is also a notable point. Jung's supporters, who used a 'birthday voting' strategy during the preliminary race—dispersing votes by two based on birth month—are now sharing a plan ahead of the regional tour primaries starting next month on the 1st: voting for the high-profile candidate Choi, while those born in odd months vote for Han and those born in even months vote for Lee. <<> Unlike candidate Jung, who formalized a 'Team Jung Cheong-rae' running mate approach, party leader candidates Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil have not publicly announced formal alliances with specific Supreme Council candidates. However, as the factional showdown intensifies closer to voting day, party leader candidates are expected to exert influence to elect Supreme Council candidates close to them. <<> A lawmaker assisting candidate Kim Min-seok told *The Hankyoreh* on this day, "With five pro-Lee candidates, it's burdensome to publicly single out and support three specific ones, but since the dynamics have shifted from the preliminaries, the strategy will be determined through political judgment." Another lawmaker close to Kim Min-seok added, "Rather than dividing into pro-Kim Min-seok and pro-Song Young-gil factions, it might be more effective for the pro-Lee faction to unite and confront the pro-Jung Cheong-rae faction." <<> Meanwhile, there are also concerns over the failure of youth candidates in their 20s and 30s—such as party leader candidate Kim Bo-mi and Supreme Council candidates Jeong Min-cheol and Kim Hyung-nam—to advance to the main race. Among the party leader and Supreme Council candidates who made it to the finals, Han Min-soo, born in 1969, is the youngest. A multi-term lawmaker said, "Seeing youth Supreme Council candidates fail to pass the preliminaries, we need to engage in a lot of self-reflection. The new leadership must present bold youth policies to the public." <<> Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 최고위원 선거 본선 진출자가 가려진 가운데, 친이재명계(5명)와 친정청래계(3명)의 경쟁 구도 속에서 지도부 과반을 확보하기 위한 계파별 수싸움이 치열하게 전개될 전망이다. 9명으로 구성되는 새 지도부에서 특정 계파가 당대표와 지명직 최고위원 2명을 포함해 과반(5명)을 확보하려면, 선출직 최고위원 최소 2명을 당선시켜야 한다.)

item.title: Kim Jong-hoon, Former Lawmaker, Elected New Leader of Progressive Party: "Evolving into a Viable Alternative Party to Halt Runaway Inequality" (진보당 새 대표에 김종훈 전 의원…“불평등 폭주 멈출 대안정당 도약”)
item.description:
Candidate Kim Jong-hoon has been elected as the new leader of the Progressive Party. (진보당 신임 당대표에 김종훈 후보가 선출됐다.)

On the 24th, the Progressive Party announced the results of the election for its 4th-term party leader and supreme council members. In the two-candidate race for party leader, Kim secured 62.51% of the vote, comfortably defeating candidate Lee Seong-su (26.452%). The newly elected leader Kim previously served as a member of the 20th National Assembly and was re-elected as mayor of Ulsan's Dong-gu district. (진보당은 24일 4기 당대표·최고위원 선거 결과를 발표했다. 2인 경선으로 치러진 대표 선거에선 김 후보가 62.51%를 득표해 이성수 후보(26.452%)에 여유있게 승리했다. 김 신임 대표는 20대 국회의원과 재선 울산동구청장을 지냈다.)

Leader Kim stated, "I deeply cherish the expectations and heavy responsibilities entrusted by our party members and will surely repay them with tangible results." He added, "We will leap forward as a strong Progressive Party capable of stopping the surge of inequality and become a definitive alternative party." He continued, "Our most critical task is to win the 2028 general election," and emphasized, "As a mass party preparing to govern, we will focus all our capabilities on winning the general election, achieving a parliamentary negotiating group and firmly establishing ourselves as a third political force." (김 대표는 “당원들의 기대와 무거운 책임을 가슴에 새기고 반드시 성과로 보답하겠다”며 “불평등 폭주를 멈출 강한 진보당, 확실한 대안정당으로 도약하겠다”고 밝혔다. 이어 “가장 중요한 과제는 2028년 총선 승리”라며 “집권을 준비하는 대중정당으로서 모든 역량을 총선 승리에 집중해 원내교섭단체 실현과 제3정당으로의 확고한 자리매김을 이뤄내겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

In the election for the five supreme council members, all five candidates (Song Young-ju, Kim Hyun-jong, Shin Chang-hyun, Jeong Tae-hong, and Jang Jin-sook) who ran were confirmed elected. For the leadership of the Youth Progressive Party, where a single-candidate approval vote was held, candidate Lee Hae-ji was elected. (5명을 선출하는 최고위원 선거에는 5명의 후보(송영주·김현종·신창현·정태홍·장진숙)가 출마해 전원 당선이 확정됐다. 단독 출마로 찬반 투표가 치러진 청년진보당 대표에는 이해지 후보가 선출됐다.)

The Progressive Party had previously operated under a co-leadership system with acting leaders and co-leaders, but with this new leadership, it has transitioned to a single party leader system. (진보당은 그간 상임대표와 공동대표들이 함께하는 공동 대표 체제로 운영됐으나 이번 지도부부터 당 대표 체제로 전환했다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam, wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "In the AI Era, K-shaped Polarization... Responses Must Differ from the Past" (김용범 “AI시대, 케이(K)자형 양극화…기존 대응과는 달라야”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom, chief of the presidential office's policy unit, commented on U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's remarks about "Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix expanding production facilities in the U.S.," saying, "This is not a new story." (김용범 청와대 정책실장이 하워드 러트닉 미국 상무장관의 ‘삼성전자·에스케이(SK) 하이닉스 미국 내 생산시설 확대’ 발언에 대해 “새로운 이야기는 아니다”라고 말했다.)

According to foreign media, including the Associated Press and the New York Times on the 24th, Kim stated during a briefing with foreign correspondents the previous day, "The U.S. has long hoped and aimed to increase its domestic share of memory (semiconductor) production." Kim added, "Since every country wants to build semiconductor plants within their borders, it's natural for the U.S. Commerce Secretary to say that." He highlighted, "(From the perspective of big tech companies) It's more important to have memory fabs built in a timely manner to meet their demand, rather than whether those fabs are built in Korea or the U.S." This seems to emphasize that Secretary Lutnick's remarks were of a routine nature. Secretary Lutnick had previously said on the 9th (local time) at an event hosted by U.S. memory maker Micron, "The CEO of Micron won't like it, but I want to bring his competitors, Samsung and SK Hynix, to the U.S. and have them build factories." (24일 에이피(AP) 통신과 뉴욕타임스 등 외신에 따르면, 김 실장은 전날 외신기자 간담회에서 “미국은 자국 내 메모리 (반도체) 생산 포션이 늘어났으면 하는 게 예전부터 희망이고 목표였다”며 이렇게 밝혔다. 김 실장은 “모든 나라가 다 반도체 공장을 자국 내에 건설하고 싶어 하니까 당연히 미국 상무장관은 할 수 있는 말”이라며 “(빅테크 회사 입장에선) 한국에 짓느냐 미국에 짓느냐보다 본인들의 수요를 맞춰줄 수 있는 메모리 팹이 적기에 건설되는 것이 더 중요하다”고 했다. 러트닉 장관의 발언이 통상적인 수준이란 점을 강조한 것으로 보인다. 러트닉 장관은 지난 9일(현지시각) 미국 메모리 제조사 마이크론이 개최한 행사에 참석해 “마이크론 최고경영자는 좋아하지 않겠지만, 그의 경쟁사인 삼성과 에스케이 하이닉스를 미국으로 데려와 공장을 짓게 하고 싶다”고 밝힌 바 있다.)

Regarding responses to K-shaped polarization, Kim said, "Since Korea is the country where this phenomenon has been most pronounced, I think we need to find our own solutions." Kim noted, "Jobless growth in the AI era looks different from what it was 10 or 15 years ago," adding, "Responses must differ from the past. We are trying to find new and proactive methods." On measures such as strengthening the basic deposit requirements for single-stock leveraged products, he said, "It seems they are trying to expedite the timeline to the end of July," and added, "We are preparing to also implement other measures a bit earlier." (김 실장은 케이(K)자형 양극화 대응 방안에 대해서는 “우리나라가 이런 현상이 제일 크게 벌어진 나라니까 우리만의 솔루션을 찾아야 되지 않을까 생각한다”고 말했다. 김 실장은 “에이아이(AI) 시대의 고용 없는 성장은 예전 10년, 15년 전과 다른 모습”이라며 “기존 대응과는 달라야 한다. 새로운 방법, 적극적인 방법을 찾아보려고 하고 있다”고 했다. 아울러 단일종목 레버리지 상품의 기본 예탁금 강화 등의 조처에 대해서는 “7월 말까지 (시점을) 당기려고 그러는 것 같다”며 “다른 것들도 조금 당겨서 시행하려고 준비를 하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee received the 'Lee Jung-hoo autograph ball'... AI Heart Division Jensen Hwang and others hold a series of meetings (‘이정후 사인볼’ 받은 이 대통령… AI 심장부서 젠슨황 등 연쇄 회동)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, who has embarked on a tour of the United States and South America, arrived in San Francisco, USA, on the 24th (local time). (미국·남미 순방길에 오른 이재명 대통령이 24일(현지시각) 미국 샌프란시스코에 도착했다.)

President Lee and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung arrived at San Francisco Airport at around 8:23 a.m. that day. Mayor Daniel Lury, Ambassador to the U.S. Kang Kyung-hwa, and Consul General Lim Jung-taek in San Francisco attended to welcome President Lee and his wife. ( 이 대통령과 김혜경 여사는 이날 오전 8시23분께 샌프란시스코 공항에 도착했다. 대니얼 루리 시장과 강경화 주미대사, 임정택 주샌프란시스코 총영사 등이 나와 이 대통령 부부를 맞았다.)

Mayor Daniel handed over a signed ball from Lee Jung-hoo, who plays for the San Francisco Giants, and President Lee said, "Thank you," shook hands, and then smiled and chatted. The San Francisco protocol officer presented Mrs. Kim with a red bouquet. ( 대니얼 시장은 샌프란시스코 자이언츠에서 뛰고 있는 이정후 선수의 ‘사인볼’을 전달했고, 이 대통령은 “감사하다”고 말하며 악수한 뒤 웃으며 대화를 나눴다. 샌프란시스코 의전장은 김 여사에게 빨간색 꽃다발을 전달했다.)

Afterwards, President Lee and his wife got into the waiting vehicle and left the airport. ( 이후 이 대통령 부부는 대기하고 있던 차량을 타고 공항을 빠져나갔다.)

On the morning of the same day, President Lee first met with Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic. President Lee met Amode's CEO at a hotel in downtown San Francisco and said, "I am very pleased and delighted to meet such a world-renowned figure," adding, "Since Korea plans to significantly expand investment in the field of artificial intelligence going forward, I look forward to Anthropic's special interest, investment, and contributions." (이 대통령은 이날 오전 다리오 아모데이 앤트로픽 최고경영자(CEO)를 가장 먼저 면담했다. 이 대통령은 샌프란시스코 시내 한 호텔에서 아모데이 최고경영자를 만나 “세계적으로 유명한 분을 이렇게 뵙게 돼서 매우 반갑고 또 기쁘다”며 “대한민국이 앞으로 인공지능 분야에 투자를 대대적으로 확대할 생각이기 때문에 우리 앤트로픽의 각별한 관심과 투자, 또 기여를 기대한다”고 말했다.)

In response, Amodei's CEO said, "Anthropic prioritizes collaboration with companies. As a business-oriented company, we are collaborating with Korean firms in many fields, and expectations for this are very high," adding, "Korean memory companies have invested heavily in Anthropic, and in that regard, we plan to collaborate in data centers and various other fields." ( 이에 아모데이 최고경영자는 “앤트로픽은 기업과의 협력을 가장 우선순위로 두고 있다. 사업 중심의 기업인 만큼 많은 분야에서 한국 기업들과 함께하고 있고, 또 그에 대한 기대도 매우 높다”며 “한국의 메모리 업체들이 앤트로픽에 투자도 많이 해 주셨고, 그런 면에서 데이터 센터와 그 외 여러 분야에서 함께 협력할 계획”이라고 화답했다. )

President Lee will then meet with Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, Jensen Huang, CEO of Nvidia, and Huk Tan, CEO of Broadcom, among others. Kim Yong-beom, Chief of Policy at the Blue House, said at a briefing on the 23rd, "Through meetings with CEOs of big tech companies, we will emphasize Korea's commitment to full investment in AI and global cooperation, and we plan to achieve tangible results through investment and cooperation with key companies in the global AI supply chain."
